measurements.name: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current
measurements.geographic_scope: Svinøy repeat section across the Norwegian continental slope; source-defined slope branch.
measurements.layer: Lateral extent at 50 m; variable core shape reaches about 460 m.
measurements.boundary_rule: Fastest mean absolute-geostrophic-velocity cells supplying 50% of mean Atlantic-Water transport, within salinity and shoreward-isobath domain; no paired geographic edges transcribed.
measurements.temporal_interpretation: Static core defined from 30-year mean fields, not a mean of instantaneous widths. Uneven seasonal sampling retained; no monthly width series.
measurements.source_citation: Baumann et al. (2026), Ocean Science22,17–29, doi:10.5194/os-22-17-2026.
measurements.source_locator: Section2.1.2, printed19–21/PDF3–5; Svinøy paragraph and Figure3a.
measurements.source_access: Original publisher PDF/XML retained; methods and Figure3 visually inspected2026-10-21.
measurements.extraction_method: Direct reported prose quantities, independently checked against original pages; no image digitization or velocity reconstruction.
measurements.source_quality_note: 50 km box-model width is a separate modeling choice. Core areas at different sections and previous width operators cannot be combined into an area, trend or seasonal range.
